# Maa Jagadhatri Pooja, Saidapur

> The official website of Maa Jagadhatri Pooja, a family pooja celebrated every year since 1901 at Saidapur, District Godda, Jharkhand, India — by the Kamlakant Jha family.

## Event

- **[Maa Jagadhatri Pooja 2026](https://maajagadhatrisaidapur.vercel.app/)**: Official site with the 2026 dates (Maha Saptami 17 Nov, Maha Ashtami 18 Nov, Maha Navami 19 Nov, and Visarjan on Ekadashi 20 Nov), schedule, story, gallery, FAQs and contact.

## History

- The pooja commemorates the birth of Late Kamlakant Jha (1900–1968), son of Late Heera Jha, a barrister of Kolkata University (1882).
- Heera Jha vowed at the Chandannagar Jagadhatri Pooja that he would worship the Goddess yearly if blessed with a son. A flower fell into Mrs. Jha's lap during immersion; Kamlakant Jha was born in 1900 and worship began at Saidapur in 1901.
- Kamlakant Jha had six sons (Krishna Kant, Vishnu Kant, Nishi Kant, Avni Kant, Saroj Kant, Shyama Kant Jha) and a daughter (Sharda Devi).

## Rituals

- The pooja process is Tantrik; Maa Jagadhatri represents power and peace and blesses devotees with offspring.
- On Akshaya Navami, Trikala Pooja runs from the morning and a Havan is performed afterwards; the Acharya distributes offered flowers to devotees on Sanyam.
- Idols are immersed in the Kajhiya river on Ekadashi with a grand procession; afterwards juniors bow to elders for blessings.
